slot_scores.name: van_ev_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the constraint that you must use at least one trip of either vans or electric
slot_scores.rationale: The agent's earlier turn 5 'Are there any other constraints or requirements' is a vague catch-all and the mutual-exclusion fact was volunteered by the simulator. The agent's follow-up (turn 6) probes the van/EV constraint but asks whether at least one must be used, not whether vans and EVs must be mutually exclusive, so the key meaning of the slot is only indirectly touched.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_pollution_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize total transportation cost, and if so, what is the cost per trip for each vehicle type (truck, van, motorcycle, electric vehicle)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective function, clarifying what to optimize, and the user confirmed it is minimizing total pollution, resolving the P0 objective slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was directly confirmed in turn 1 and the P1 mutual-exclusion constraint was surfaced and clarified in turns 5-6 before READY_TO_MODEL, so all P0/P1 slots were resolved and no core modeling facts were left unconfirmed.

summary: The agent directly confirmed the P0 objective and surfaced/clarified the van-EV mutual-exclusion constraint before declaring READY_TO_MODEL; the only weakness is that the mutual-exclusion point was elicited largely via a vague catch-all question rather than an explicit probe.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
